title: asclepias glaucescens var. elata
intro: Asclepias glaucescens var. elata, commonly known as Elata Milkweed, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant is known for its milky sap and clusters of small, fragrant flowers, which attract pollinators such as bees and butterflies. Elata Milkweed has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help soothe wounds and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of Elata Milkweed include cardenolides, alkaloids, and other compounds with potential therapeutic actions, such as vasodilation and immunomodulation.
